q: The Bankers' Books Evidence Bill, 2026 was introduced to replace which colonial-era legislation?
explanation: The Bill seeks to replace the 135-year-old Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 1891.

q: The primary objective of the Bankers' Books Evidence Bill, 2026 is to:
options: Align legal evidence standards with digital and cloud-based banking
explanation: The Bill modernizes legal evidence standards to suit digital, virtual, and cloud-based banking.

q: Who introduced the Bankers' Books Evidence Bill, 2026 in the Lok Sabha?
explanation: The Finance Minister introduced the Bill on August 3, 2026.

q: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) approved a one-year extension for which two senior officials?
options: Chief Election Commissioner and Attorney General
Cabinet Secretary T.V. Somanathan and Home Secretary Govind Mohan
NITI Aayog CEO and RBI Governor
explanation: The ACC approved one-year extensions for Cabinet Secretary Dr. T.V. Somanathan and Union Home Secretary Govind Mohan.

q: Who chairs the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC)?
explanation: The ACC is chaired by the Prime Minister of India.

q: Which organization released the report titled 'Reimagining Care: Strategies for Empowering Caregivers in Viksit Bharat@2047'?
explanation: The report was released by NITI Aayog.

q: The 'Reimagining Care' report aims to position India as a global hub for:
explanation: The report proposes making India a global hub for skilled caregivers.

q: The Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) Bill, 2026 proposes converting ISI into a:
explanation: The Bill proposes converting ISI into a not-for-profit statutory body corporate.

q: Under the proposed ISI Bill, 2026, who will serve as the 'Visitor' of the Indian Statistical Institute?
explanation: The Bill designates the President of India as the Visitor of ISI.

q: The RBI plans to resume On-Tap Licensing for which category of banks?
explanation: The RBI will issue draft guidelines for On-Tap Licensing of Urban Cooperative Banks.

q: According to RBI's plan, polymer banknotes are expected to be introduced from:
explanation: The RBI plans to introduce polymer banknotes from FY2027-28 (FY28), subject to successful trials.

q: One major advantage of polymer banknotes is:
options: Higher durability and better security features
explanation: Polymer notes last longer and include enhanced anti-counterfeiting security features.

q: The 16th Finance Commission retained vertical tax devolution to states at:
explanation: The Commission retained the vertical tax devolution share at 41%.

q: The 16th Finance Commission reduced the share of Grants-in-Aid from 19.4% to:
explanation: The share of Grants-in-Aid was reduced to 8.3%, leading to debates on Centre-State fiscal relations.

q: Which state recorded the third-highest number of financial fraud cases over the last three financial years?
explanation: According to the Union Ministry of Finance, Haryana recorded the third-highest number of financial fraud cases after Maharashtra and Delhi.

q: The 'Seafarer-First' response initiative was launched following attacks in which strategic waterway?
explanation: The 'Seafarer-First' response was launched after attacks on merchant vessels carrying Indian crew members in the Strait of Hormuz.

q: The 'Seafarer-First' initiative is primarily intended to protect whom?
explanation: The initiative aims to address emergencies faced by Indian seafarers.

q: Which company's rocket stage is believed to have crashed into the Moon on August 5, 2026?
explanation: Researchers believe the upper stage of a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket impacted the Moon.

q: The reported impact of the SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket stage on the Moon has raised concerns mainly about:
explanation: The incident has renewed discussions on the long-term impact of space debris.

q: Which U.S. state and city officially declared August 15 as 'India Day'?
explanation: The State of Massachusetts and the city of Boston declared August 15 as India Day.

q: Which European river has recorded historically low water levels due to prolonged heatwaves and drought?
explanation: The Danube River has experienced record-low water levels across several European countries.

q: The Danube River is the _____ longest river in Europe.
explanation: The Danube is Europe's second-longest river after the Volga.

q: Environmentalists have raised concerns over mining of which mineral near the Gir Forest ecosystem?
explanation: The proposed limestone mining near the Babarkot corridor could disrupt the movement of Asiatic lions.

q: Who was one of the recipients of the Dr. M.S. Swaminathan Award for Environment Protection 2026?
explanation: P. Pechiyammal and Govindhammal received the Dr. M.S. Swaminathan Award for Environment Protection 2026.

q: The Dr. M.S. Swaminathan Award for Environment Protection 2026 was presented in which city?
explanation: The awards were presented during an event held in Chennai.

q: According to NITI Aayog's 'Reimagining Care' report, strengthening the care economy will primarily help in:
options: Supporting the ageing population, empowering women, and generating employment
explanation: The report emphasizes that a stronger caregiving ecosystem will support India's ageing population, empower women, and create employment.

q: The Supreme Court has extended the mandatory validity of which insurance for newly purchased private vehicles?
explanation: The Supreme Court extended the mandatory third-party insurance period to improve road safety and compliance.

q: The National Joint Outbreak Response Team (NJORT) was deployed to investigate outbreaks of which disease?
explanation: NJORT was deployed to Gujarat and Rajasthan to investigate Chandipura Virus Disease outbreaks.

q: The UP Private Business Park Development Scheme, 2025 aims to establish world-class business parks through which model?
explanation: The scheme focuses on developing Plug & Play Business Parks through the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.

q: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Air India?
explanation: Former Ethiopian Airlines CEO Tewolde Gebremariam has been appointed as the new CEO of Air India.
